But here's the thing: four of these five are already in trouble, and they don't even know it. Because life doesn't ask how much you earn before it sends a shock — a job loss, a hospital bill, a death in the family. It only asks how prepared you are. In this video, I break down why the person who looks like the biggest failure might be the only one actually winning, the difference between income and wealth, and the one question you should be asking yourself instead of "how much do I make?"
